deadline.value: PhD applications for Fall 2027 are due December 15, 2026; later applications are accepted if space is available.
deadline.quote: Fall Admissions: December 15, but will accept late applications if space is available.

gre_general.value: The GRE is recommended but not required for chemistry graduate programs.
gre_general.quote: Applicants to our graduate programs do not require the GRE, it is recommended but not required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Admission does not need a faculty agreement; students join a research group before their second semester.
supervisor.quote: The student should formally choose and be accepted into the research group of a full-time professor in our department prior to the start of the student’s 2nd semester in the program.

funding.value: The department says admitted PhD students are generally offered full packages: tuition for up to five years, an assistantship and a stipend.
funding.quote: students who are offered admission to the PhD program are also offered | full tuition coverage for up to 5 years, plus assistantship, plus stipend

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a bachelor's degree in science or engineering with the listed chemistry background.
entry_route.quote: must hold a bachelor’s degree in science or engineering that includes a background in the fundamental areas of chemistry

toefl_min.value: The chemistry PhD minimum for international applicants is TOEFL 100.
toefl_min.quote: For international students applying to the PhD program, the minimum score of TOEFL is 100

ielts_min.value: The chemistry PhD minimum for international applicants is IELTS 7.0 with no band below 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (band/subscores) is 7.0 with no individual band score of less than 6.0

notes: Department states its own TOEFL, IELTS and GRE rules, which replace the school-wide ones.
